_comment: The held cannon: the rear carriage, the front carriage one block along its facing, and the barrel where CannonBlockEntityRenderer poses it at zero elevation -- composed into one model and shifted so its centroid is the block centre. Generated from the three deployed models, so re-run the generator rather than hand-editing this. Scales are cut from the vanilla block-item defaults because a cannon is two blocks long, not one; the inventory icon is NOT this model, it is the drawn sprite at item/cannon.
